## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Skittish Start | The animal bolts or refuses to settle. The attempt begins badly, and the creature will not cooperate until the situation changes. | Low |  |
| 14-16 | Startled Beast | You move too fast or speak at the wrong moment. The animal panics and the attempt must be made again later. | Low |  |
| 21-23 | Bite or Claw | The animal lashes out in fear. Suffer 1 point of damage to Empathy or Agility, GM's choice. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Broken Lead | A lead, rope, or rein snaps. The animal breaks free and must be caught again before you can continue. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Wrong Signal | You misread the animal's behavior and push too hard. The attempt fails, and the animal becomes more difficult to calm. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Exhausted Mount | You push the mount too far and tire it out. The animal is exhausted and cannot be ridden or trained further until it rests. | High |  |
| 41-43 | Unwanted Attention | Your efforts draw the notice of nearby predators or people. A hostile or curious presence approaches the scene. | Moderate |  |
| 44-46 | Mud and Panic | The animal thrashes into mud, brush, or equipment and throws the whole attempt into chaos. You lose time and must start over later. | Moderate |  |
| 51-53 | Escape Attempt | The animal slips its bonds and runs. You must recover it before the work can continue. | High |  |
| 54-56 | Dangerous Kick | A mount or large beast lashes out hard. Suffer an attack with four Base Dice, causing damage to Agility or Strength. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Training Setback | The animal remembers the stress of the encounter and resists you afterward. Any future attempt to handle it becomes harder until it is calmed or rested. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Fatal Fright | The animal bolts into danger, wrecks gear, or injures someone nearby before you can stop it. The situation spirals into a severe mishap. | Catastrophic |  |
